neighbours.label: Bank lending and credit (loan, credit, banks, lender): money extended to a borrower, vs the same sentences about borrowing or asking for non-financial things
fire: The couple went to the bank to ask for a loan for their first house.
Many students take out loans to pay for college.
Banks tightened credit for small firms after the crisis.
The farmer borrowed money from a local lender to buy seed.
Without a good credit score, getting a mortgage is hard.
The startup secured a bank loan to expand its factory.
Lenders charge higher interest when credit risk rises.
She paid off her car loan two years early.
quiet: The couple went to the park to ask for directions to their hotel.
Many students take part-time jobs to pay for college.
Storms tightened supplies for small farms after the flood.
The farmer borrowed a tractor from a neighbour to plough the field.
Without a good night's sleep, getting through exams is hard.
The startup hired an engineer to expand its factory.
Prices rise higher in summer when tourism grows.
She finished her degree two years early.

notes: Card: ' loan' x6, ' credit' x4, ' loans' x4, ' banks', Japanese 融資. Probe: 'give a loan to' 0.668, 'hostage by banks' 0.615, 'personal loan' 0.597; 'give advice' 0.108, 'library will lend you a book' 0.012, 'right to credit of their own' 0.119 (lower than the card example).
